title: The Agricultural Revolution: Crash Course World History #1
summary: The first episode of Crash Course World History, in which John Green covers the shift from hunting and gathering to agriculture and how it shaped civilization. It is delivered fast and with jokes.
why: HN recommends the series as a funny, coherent high-school-level overview of world history that teaches a lot in a few hours.

quote.text: This series taught me in a few hours what I didn't learn in school over years
